# RoomCraft

> RoomCraft is a browser-local 2D room planner whose WebMCP mutations update the same canvas and undo history as human edits.

Use get_room_state first. Configure room dimensions and settings, search the fictional generic catalog or create custom items, then add/place/update furniture and openings. Run validate_layout after changes and save a layout variant when useful. IDs come from tool results or `get_room_state`; mutations are undoable. State is browser-local and persisted. Source URLs on custom items are metadata only and are never fetched.

Geometry uses centimetres with a northwest interior origin: x increases east and y increases south. Furniture x/y coordinates are footprint centres. Opening offsets run from the wall start: north/south openings measure from west, and east/west openings measure from north.

## WebMCP tools

- `get_room_state`
- `set_room_dimensions`
- `set_room_settings`
- `add_opening`
- `update_opening`
- `remove_opening`
- `search_furniture`
- `create_custom_item`
- `place_furniture`
- `update_furniture`
- `remove_furniture`
- `apply_layout`
- `validate_layout`
- `save_layout_variant`
- `activate_layout_variant`
- `reset_current_layout`
- `undo_last_change`
